newsitem.title: USA: CSCE BFP Milk futures reach record trading volume.
newsitem.headline: CSCE BFP Milk futures reach record trading volume.

text.p: Coffee, Sugar and Cocoa Exchange (CSCE) said on Wednesday BFP Milk futures contracts set a record volume of 199 contracts on July 15.
On the same day, open interest on BFP Milk futures reached a record high of 1,236 contracts, the exchange said in a statement.

The BFP Milk futures contract, which was launched by CSCE on April 8, is cash settled against the Basic Formula Price (BFP) for milk, an index calculated and announced monthly by the U.S. Department of Agriculture.

"After only three months of trading, we are quite impressed by the industry's focus on this market," said CSCE president James Bowe. "As more members of the dairy industry recognize the benefits of trading BFP futures and options, the foundation of support will continue to strengthen."
